S1.label: Structured data reasoning
S1.description: Fails to parse/cross-reference structured data from tools.
key_patterns: Searching wrong route (A15/A16: picked non-cheapest flight, A32: wrong itinerary constraint check)
Wrong item matching when attributes must be cross-referenced across products (R5-R9: wrong water bottle/lamp pairing, R20/R23/R27: wrong variant selection)
Failing to identify most expensive/highest-resolution item from product catalog (R52, R64, R82, R83)
Missed counting all product variants when queried (R3, R4: 10 T-shirt count wrong)
Wrong item selected based on conditional attribute filter (R12, R49, R93, R107)

S2.label: Tool calling precision
key_patterns: Wrong item_ids in exchange call (A8: extra item included, R1: extra keyboard item included)
Wrong number of nonfree_baggages (A17: set 3 nonfree instead of 0; A29: set 1 nonfree instead of 0)
Wrong origin/destination passed to booking tool (A24: EWR/LAX instead of JFK/SEA)
Wrong payment_id used (A25: unused certificates not applied correctly)
Wrong item IDs passed to modify_pending_order_items (R109, R110: modified wrong item)

S3.label: Multi-step task completion
key_patterns: Stopped after partial completion - missed subsequent reservations (A18: only JG7FMM downgraded, 4 others missed)
Dropped sub-task: forgot to book second/third passenger reservations (A23)
Cancelled extra reservations beyond scope (A39: cancelled all instead of only upcoming)
Multi-order operations: returned wrong/extra items from wrong orders (R91, R92: included smart watch)
Address change done but item modification missed (R71, R72, R97, R111, R112)
Partial return/cancel/exchange - only some required items processed (R33, R34, R60, R82, R83)
Wrong order in multi-step: address change before item change caused failure (R41, R42)

S4.label: Precondition verification
key_patterns: Cancelled non-cancellable reservations (Basic Economy, >24h, no insurance): A9 cancelled IFOYYZ, A26, A35, A37, A43, A47
Changed flight when not allowed (changed origin/destination: A13; changed date without valid exception: A36)
Tried to modify partial passengers/flights within a reservation (A10: partial cabin change, A33: one leg only)
Acted before checking eligibility criteria: issued unsolicited compensation (A2), removed bags when prohibited (A30)
Attempted passenger removal which policy prohibits (A11, A24)
Did not verify insurance/status before cancellation (A49: insurance invalid for illness)

S5.label: Numerical reasoning
key_patterns: Wrong total savings calculation (A18: calculated only 2 of 5 reservations' savings)
Wrong payment split across certificates/cards (A20: miscalculated remainder after certificate use)
Wrong total refund stated to user (R16: stated wrong total; R46: wrong remaining item total)
Wrong price difference calculation (R44: stated wrong delta for item change)
Wrong flight duration classification used to determine which reservations to cancel (A44)

S6.label: Record discovery and retrieval
key_patterns: Looked at wrong reservation (A38: checked SDZQKO instead of 4OG6T3; A22: used UM3OG5 instead of FQ8APE)
Couldn't find user after multiple lookup attempts (A27: tried wrong user ID; R22, R54: zip/email mismatch)
Found wrong order/item in multi-order context (R21, R25, R28: grabbed items from wrong order)
Did not retrieve all reservations to identify target (A21: stopped before finding OBUT9V)
Used wrong order ID format (R41, R42: '#8829105' instead of '#W9583042'; R104: completely fictitious IDs)
Wrong item identified as more expensive in set (R82, R83, R99)

S7.label: Information communication
S7.description: Right action, fails to state values.
key_patterns: Issued wrong certificate amount (A2: $300 instead of $50; A38: $150 instead of $50)
Failed to state individual refund amounts when DB correctly processed (R19: didn't say $54.04 and $41.64)
Failed to state total paid/order amount (R67: did not say $829.43; R103: did not give tracking number)
Failed to mention material information user asked about (R24: didn't state polyester/cotton)
Didn't present multiple pricing options before executing (R29: didn't list $180.10/$189.57/$208.60)
Didn't communicate total refund amount (R33, R34: total $1093.34 not mentioned)
Wrong price stated in confirmation (R44: stated wrong delta amount; R46: wrong remaining total)

S8.label: Conditional and state-aware reasoning
S8.description: Ignores if-then or wrong API for state.
key_patterns: Wrong tool for order state: used exchange_delivered on a pending order (R74, R79, R102); used modify_pending on delivered order (R65)
Cancelled entire order instead of modifying item (R37, R57: should remove single item but cancelled whole order)
Did not follow if-then conditional instructions (A19: change if possible else cancel - changed instead of cancelling; R76: remove item if possible else cancel whole order)
Used wrong API for reservation state (A14: should cancel+rebook not update; A23: same pattern)
Ignored state: processed exchange when user just wanted tracking number (R30); transferred to human instead of looking up address from other order (R101)
Acted on emotional manipulation: refused valid exchange (R80) or offered unsolicited high compensation (A2)
Wrong payment routing for cross-order refund swap (R10)
Applied wrong policy exception (A36: bereavement not valid; A31: nonstop change without valid entitlement)
